arguments.prompt:
Create one native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Professor Azimuth. FIXED INCARNATION: Woodruff and the Schnibble of Azimuth (1994). APPEARANCE: Elderly eccentric Professor Azimuth with white hair, prominent nose, round spectacles and practical pale laboratory coat over dark trousers; small laboratory control apparatus.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: Viblefrotzer laboratory controls; growth apparatus is not a gun. SOURCE ACTION: Calibrage prudent du Viblefrotzer. Azimuth built the Viblefrotzer that aged Woodruff. Laboratory preparation and safe calibration are adapted support; neither a Viblefrotzer combat pulse nor reversed growth is asserted.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four different approaching/ready postures. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief source-personality acknowledgments. Columns5-8 ROUND LOSS: four different disappointed/breathing/steady postures, completely unharmed.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Use only the fixed practical support tool or an unarmed helpful signal: prepare, look/examine, clear helpful gesture in THIRD pose, settle. No attack ray, magic barrier, weapon or offensive summon. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct celebrations DIFFERENT from the round-win group.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. Columns5-8 SUPER: Use only the fixed practical support tool or an unarmed helpful signal: prepare, look/examine, clear helpful gesture in THIRD pose, settle. No attack ray, magic barrier, weapon or offensive summon. Four NEW drawings, different from row3.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four different breathing/weight/wing/ear poses. Columns5-8 RUN: four actual alternating locomotion strides; flying or serpentine movement uses the real anatomy.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Use only the fixed practical support tool or an unarmed helpful signal: prepare, look/examine, clear helpful gesture in THIRD pose, settle. No attack ray, magic barrier, weapon or offensive summon. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.
